title: Awesome Crystal Prototype: a curated list of crystal structural prototype libraries, algorithms, databases, and CSP resources
description: A curated list of resources on crystal structural prototypes: libraries, comparison algorithms, source databases, and discovery and crystal structure prediction methods. Includes machine-readable library tables, a bibliography, and family-level results of a GraphID analysis of ICSD, Materials Project, OQMD, and LeMat-Bulk samples. Accompanies the survey A Comprehensive Survey of Crystal Structural Prototypes: Construction, Classification, and Applications.
